model.title: Diesel Emissions Reduction Act of 2025
model.meta: Energy and Commerce Committee · Rep. Doris Matsui (D-CA)

summary.text: The bill would extend a federal program that helps fund the replacement or upgrade of diesel engines with cleaner technology through 2029, allowing the Environmental Protection Agency to continue awarding grants, rebates, and loans for these pollution-reduction projects.
